name: app-shefaa-arabic-medical-app-cover-over-hospital-photo
title: Shefaa Arabic medical app cover: two phones over a blue-tinted hospital photo with store badges
whatItIs: A cover with a blue-tinted photo of a doctor helping a patient, two phones showing an Arabic health home screen (services grid, doctors, banners), App Store and Google Play badges, a heart-shield logo and an Arabic tagline.
whatItMeans: Caring and reliable; the real clinic photo grounds the app in human care.
techniques: Tint a background photo in the brand blue.
Float two phones at slightly different angles.
Add store badges to signal a real product.

vocabulary.definition: Official App Store and Google Play buttons.
A single colour laid over a photo.
